text: See bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED. This epic closes the statistical 0.1 gate with a certification, but the existing certification-report.md SHA-256 b6684bc0... was computed over a working tree that was never committed - HEAD b5d9a33 does not contain measurement.R, tomography.R, or 14 other R files, verified with git cat-file. A second certification on the same tree inherits the same defect. Epic 9 acceptance should require the certified artifact to correspond to a named commit hash, recorded alongside the content SHA.
